name: nadir-route
description: Right-size every prompt and every subagent spawn. A UserPromptSubmit hook asks Nadir's free decision API which tier the prompt needs and, when a cheaper tier suffices, gives the agent Nadir's read and a pick from five worker agents (each a fixed model and effort: Haiku; Sonnet at low, medium or high effort; Opus at medium), and the agent decides whether to hand the work off. A PreToolUse hook right-sizes every other spawn, using your harness's own aliases so the pick stays in your model family and generation; a worker the agent picked is left as chosen. Complex work and your main thread's own model are never touched, except read-only Explore searches, which take the rung below (Sonnet under an Opus session). Fail-open: any error and the prompt or spawn proceeds exactly as intended.
